name: Mace of Disruption

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: An extra 2d6 Radiant against Fiends and Undead, and one left at 25 Hit Points or fewer makes a DC 15 Wis save or is destroyed.
text: Fiends and Undead struck by this magic mace take an extra 2d6 Radiant damage. One left with 25 Hit Points or fewer by that damage makes a Wisdom saving throw against DC 15; on a failure it is destroyed, and on a success it is Frightened until your next turn ends. In your hand, the mace glows with Bright Light out to 20 feet and Dim Light for another 20 feet.
